requirement: aero_fileplot returns a list of matplotlib Figure objects
rationale: Caller iterates and saves or displays each figure individually

requirement: Every item in the returned list is a Figure
rationale: Mixed types would break callers that iterate and call fig.savefig

requirement: The first figure is the stability figure with 6 subplots (one per coefficient)
rationale: Consistent ordering enables programmatic access by index

requirement: Stability figure axes titles include coefficient names (CLtot, CDtot, etc.)
rationale: Labels identify which subplot carries which coefficient without documentation

requirement: If no control surfaces are present exactly one figure is returned
rationale: Single-figure output for geometry-only models must not produce empty control figures

requirement: With one surface and all COEF_NAMES, seven figures are returned (1 stability + 6 control)
rationale: One figure per coefficient for each surface; count must be deterministic

requirement: Each control figure has one subplot per surface
rationale: Combines all surfaces for a given coefficient on one figure for side-by-side comparison

requirement: Each control figure suptitle contains a coefficient name
rationale: Identifies the figure when saved to disk or displayed in a multi-figure viewer

requirement: When beta_ref is not an exact breakpoint the nearest available beta is used
rationale: Exact beta values are rarely available; nearest-neighbor avoids a crash or silent empty plot
